```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The United States joined with Brazil to launch and co-chair the international Open Government Partnership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fifty-five countries now belong to the Open Government Partnership, representing a quarter of the world's people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Each of the fifty-five countries in the Open Government Partnership has outlined concrete, credible steps to open the work of government so citizens are empowered, problems are solved, and democracy is strengthened.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration has successfully pressed for international action against government corruption through the G-20.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration has promoted new initiatives to help countries develop stronger judicial institutions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The public's rights, freedoms, and access to economic opportunity depend on the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will continue to work in partnership with its allies to promote the rule of law around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to the rule of law and effective judicial institutions are essential to sustainable economic development.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The rule of law must remain a core American value in the years to come.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
